metadata.architectureStyle: Multi-Agent Loop with Runtime Deadlock Detection & Adaptive Intervention

systemFlow: Adaptive Policy Engine (Runtime Guidance + Recovery Evaluation)

components.title: Agent Orchestration
components.description: LangGraph-based multi-agent loop that drives coder and reviewer agents through iterative code generation and review cycles. Manages state transitions, turn counting, and termination logic.
responsibilities: Build and compile the LangGraph StateGraph with coder and reviewer nodes
Define agent state schema (messages, flags, tokens, iterations)
Route conditional edges between coder and reviewer based on review status, deadlock detection, and max turns
Initialize state and run the streaming workflow generator

children.title: graph.py
children.purpose: Builds the compiled LangGraph workflow with coder→reviewer loop, conditional routing, and termination logic.
responsibilities: Create StateGraph with coder and reviewer nodes
Implement should_continue() with review status, deadlock, and max-turn checks
Set entry point and conditional edges (coder→reviewer→coder)
Compile and return the executable workflow

children.title: build_graph()
children.description: Factory that creates coder/reviewer nodes, defines should_continue routing logic, and compiles the LangGraph. Accepts prompts, client, and feature flags (use_sentinel, adaptive_interventions).
children.inputs: coder_prompt: str, reviewer_prompt: str, client: OpenAI, use_sentinel: bool, adaptive_interventions: bool

children.title: should_continue()
children.description: Conditional edge router. Returns 'end' if reviewer approves, deadlock is detected (with fallback), or MAX_TURNS reached. Otherwise routes to the opposite agent (coder→reviewer→coder).

children.title: state.py
children.purpose: Defines the AgentState TypedDict schema used by LangGraph for all workflow state.
responsibilities: Define AgentState with messages, sender, iteration, flags, tokens
Track task completion, termination reasons, and intervention history

children.title: AgentState
children.description: TypedDict schema for the entire multi-agent workflow state. Fields: messages (append-annotated list), sender, iteration, flag, total_tokens, task_completed, completion_turn/reason, terminated_by_detector, interventions, active_policy, adaptive_interventions.

children.title: agents.py
children.purpose: LangGraph node factories that create coder and reviewer agent nodes. Each node calls the LLM, runs deadlock detection, records interventions, and evaluates recovery.
responsibilities: Create coder node that builds chat history, calls LLM, updates flags, records interventions
Create reviewer node that builds stateless review request, calls LLM, parses review status, updates flags
Handle LLM errors gracefully with llm_error flag
Evaluate recovery after each agent turn

children.title: make_coder_node()
children.description: Factory returning a LangGraph node. Builds prompt history with runtime guidance injection, calls LLM, updates deadlock flags, records policy interventions, and evaluates recovery outcome.

children.title: make_reviewer_node()
children.description: Factory returning a reviewer LangGraph node. Extracts task and latest coder output, builds stateless review request with optional guidance, calls LLM, parses STATUS output for approval, updates flags and interventions.

children.title: runner.py
children.purpose: Async generator that initializes agent state, runs the LangGraph, and streams per-turn events as structured dictionaries.
responsibilities: Initialize AgentState with task prompt and default values
Run compiled LangGraph via app.stream()
Yield per-turn StreamEvent with message, flags, deadlock status, interventions
Track new flags and new interventions between turns

children.title: stream_single()
children.description: Async generator that creates a compiled LangGraph, initializes state, streams events per turn. Each yield contains: message, flags, new_flags, iteration, total_tokens, deadlock, task_completed, interventions, active_policy, latest_intervention. Handles baseline and protected modes via use_sentinel and adaptive_interventions flags.
children.inputs: task: str, coder_prompt: str, reviewer_prompt: str, use_sentinel: bool = True, adaptive_interventions: bool = True

components.title: Deadlock Detection Engine
components.description: Lightweight runtime signal analysis engine that detects 7 distinct deadlock patterns in multi-agent conversations using text similarity, latency analysis, token growth tracking, and pattern matching—without expensive LLM judges.
responsibilities: Parse structured review STATUS from reviewer output
Detect exact repetition in coder/reviewer responses
Measure Jaccard similarity stagnation across agent turns
Track latency consistency as a stagnation signal
Detect open-ended question loops between reviewer and coder
Identify repeated STATUS: CHANGES_REQUIRED rejection cycles
Detect token escalation (rapid reviewer response growth)
Detect error loops (consecutive LLM failures)
Aggregate all signals into feature flags and make deadlock decisions

children.title: monitor.py
children.purpose: Core deadlock detection engine. Implements 7 detectors, unified flag update, and deadlock decision logic.
responsibilities: Parse structured review status with regex (handles markdown variants)
Detect repetition via exact normalized text matching
Compute Jaccard similarity between agent responses
Detect stagnation using reviewer (0.72) and coder (0.82) similarity thresholds
Detect latency convergence (spread < 0.2s over 3 turns)
Detect open loops (reviewer ends with ?, coder agrees)
Detect rejection loops (consecutive CHANGES_REQUIRED + high similarity)
Detect token escalation (>30% growth, consecutive growth)
Detect error loops (2+ errors in last 3 messages)
Update feature flags and make hard/soft deadlock decisions

children.title: detect_review_status()
children.description: Parses the latest reviewer message for a structured STATUS line. Handles markdown variants (**STATUS:**, __STATUS__, `STATUS`) and returns 'approved', 'changes_required', or None.

children.title: update_flag()
children.description: Orchestrator that runs all 7 detectors on updated messages and returns the current set of feature flags (llm_error, repeat, open_loop, latency, error_loop, stagnation, rejection_loop, escalation). Drops stale flags after each turn.

children.title: is_deadlock()
children.description: Deadlock decision function. Hard signals (repeat, error_loop, open_loop, llm_error) single-handedly trigger deadlock. Soft+latency combos (stagnation+latency, rejection_loop+latency, weak_progress+latency) also trigger. Escalation + iteration >= 3 triggers. Latency alone is insufficient.

children.title: detect_stagnation()
children.description: Computes Jaccard similarity between consecutive reviewer messages (threshold 0.72) and consecutive coder messages (threshold 0.82). Returns True if either exceeds threshold.

children.title: detect_rejection_loop()
children.description: Detects repeated rejection patterns. Checks for consecutive STATUS: CHANGES_REQUIRED with high similarity (>0.72), or explicit negative review language matches in both last two reviewer messages.

children.title: detect_escalation()
children.description: Detects token escalation across reviewer responses. Flags if latest reviewer tokens > 130% of running average AND there are 2+ consecutive growth steps (>10%).

children.title: detect_repetition()
children.description: Exact duplicate detection. True if the last two messages from the same sender (coder or reviewer) are identical after normalization.

children.title: detect_latency()
children.description: Checks if latency spread across last k=3 responses is below 0.2s threshold, indicating repetitive cached behavior.

children.title: detect_open_loops()
children.description: Detects when the reviewer repeatedly asks open-ended questions (ending with ?) and coder agrees (yes, sure, etc.), indicating an unproductive question loop.

children.title: detect_error_loop()
children.description: Flags when 2+ of the last 3 messages contain LLM errors, indicating cascading failures.

children.title: similarity()
children.description: Computes Jaccard similarity between two texts after markdown noise removal, stopword filtering, and reviewer label stripping. Returns 0.0-1.0 float.
children.inputs: a: str, b: str, sender: str | None

children.title: normalize_for_signal()
children.description: Normalizes agent content before similarity detection. Strips markdown, removes reviewer boilerplate labels (Category:, Severity:, etc.), filters stopwords, and returns lowercase space-joined significant words.

children.title: test_parser.py
children.purpose: Unit tests for detect_review_status, detect_rejection_loop, detect_stagnation, and update_flag with 30+ test cases covering edge cases.
responsibilities: Validate STATUS regex against plain, bold, underscore, backtick variants
Test CHANGES_REQUIRED, APPROVED, MINOR_ISSUES, PENDING variants
Verify rejection_loop and stagnation against real-world review boilerplate
Test update_flag drops stale flags across turns

components.title: Adaptive Policy Engine
components.description: Runtime intervention system that selects from 5 guidance policies based on active deadlock flags. Applies targeted instructions to coder or reviewer agents, tracks recovery outcomes, and decides whether to terminate after repeated failed interventions.
responsibilities: Define 5 intervention policies with targeted instructions (context_reduction, focused_revision, reviewer_deduplication, alternate_strategy, concise_delta)
Select highest-priority policy based on current flags
Apply cooldown logic (skip if same policy used within 2 iterations)
Record interventions with before/after metrics
Evaluate recovery by comparing metrics before and after guidance
Decide termination after failed interventions (max 2 failures or hard failure flags)

children.title: policy_engine.py
children.purpose: Complete adaptive intervention system: policy definitions, guidance builder, intervention recorder, recovery evaluator, and termination fallback logic.
responsibilities: Define RuntimeGuidance dataclass with enabled, target_agent, trigger, policy, instruction, outcome

Define 5 policies: context_reduction (escalation→coder), focused_revision (stagnation→coder), reviewer_deduplication (rejection_loop→reviewer), alternate_strategy (repeat→coder), concise_delta (latency→coder)
Select highest-priority policy matching current flags and target agent
Apply cooldown: skip if same policy was applied within COOLDOWN_ITERATIONS=2 turns
Record intervention with before_metrics (similarity, tokens, issue mentions)
Evaluate recovery: check flag cleared, similarity reduced, issues reduced, tokens reduced
Terminate if hard failure flags present or failed interventions >= MAX_FAILED_INTERVENTIONS=2

children.title: RuntimeGuidance
children.description: Dataclass representing a single policy intervention. Fields: enabled, target_agent, trigger, policy, instruction, outcome. Has to_dict() serialization method.

children.title: build_runtime_guidance()
children.description: Policy selection engine. Iterates POLICY_PRIORITY (repeat > rejection_loop > stagnation > escalation > latency). Checks if trigger flag is present, matches target_agent, and is not in cooldown. Returns enabled RuntimeGuidance or skipped/disabled fallback.
children.inputs: state: Dict[str, Any], target_agent: str | None

children.title: record_intervention()
children.description: Records a new intervention in the state if guidance is enabled. Captures current iteration and before_metrics (similarity, tokens, issue mentions) for subsequent recovery evaluation.
children.outputs: Dict with updated interventions and active_policy

children.title: evaluate_recovery()
children.description: Evaluates whether a policy intervention improved the workflow state. Compares before/after metrics based on trigger type: repeat checks flag cleared, rejection/stagnation checks similarity and issue mentions reduced, escalation/latency checks tokens reduced. Updates outcome to 'recovered' or 'failed'.
children.inputs: state: Dict, updated_state: Dict, target_agent: str
children.outputs: Dict with updated interventions and cleared active_policy

children.title: should_terminate_after_interventions()
children.description: Termination fallback decision. Returns True if hard failure flags (error_loop, llm_error, open_loop) are present, or if MAX_FAILED_INTERVENTIONS (2) failed interventions have occurred.

components.title: LLM Inference
components.description: OpenAI-compatible LLM client configured for NVIDIA-hosted models (google/gemma-4-31b-it for the baseline workflow, poolside/laguna-xs-2.1 for the protected workflow). Manages dual API keys (baseline and protected), handles request/response with latency and token tracking.
responsibilities: Initialize two OpenAI clients (baseline and protected) with NVIDIA API keys
Send chat completion requests with temperature 0.2, top_p 0.95, max_tokens 1024
Track latency, token usage, and completion tokens per request
Handle exceptions gracefully with error flag

children.title: llm_client.py
children.purpose: LLM client setup and request/response handler for NVIDIA-hosted models (google/gemma-4-31b-it / poolside/laguna-xs-2.1) via OpenAI SDK.
responsibilities: Load API keys from .env or Streamlit secrets
Create baseline_client and protected_client OpenAI instances
Send chat completion requests and parse response

children.title: request_response()
children.description: Core LLM call handler. Sends chat messages to the workflow's configured model (google/gemma-4-31b-it for baseline, poolside/laguna-xs-2.1 for protected) with temperature=0.2, top_p=0.95, max_tokens=1024. Returns (text, latency, total_tokens, completion_tokens, error_flag). Logs request messages and handles exceptions with graceful error return.
children.outputs: Tuple[str | None, float | None, int, int, bool]

children.title: prompt_builder.py
children.purpose: Constructs chat histories and review requests with proper role alternation for the NVIDIA API (strict user/assistant alternation required).
responsibilities: Build coder chat history with system prompt + runtime guidance injection
Maintain strict user/assistant role alternation for NVIDIA API compliance
Build stateless reviewer request as a single user message to avoid drift and alternation issues
Inject RuntimeGuidance section into prompts when available

children.title: build_history()
children.description: Builds coder chat history. Pins first message as user with system prompt+task+optional guidance. Adds last 4 context messages with strict role alternation (assistant, user, assistant, user...). The NVIDIA API requires even message count ending in user.
children.inputs: state: AgentState, system_prompt: str, runtime_guidance: dict | None

children.title: build_reviewer_request()
children.description: Builds a stateless reviewer request as a single user message containing: reviewer prompt+guidance, original task, and latest coder implementation. Avoiding role alternation issues and reviewer drift from accumulated context.
children.inputs: reviewer_prompt: str, task: str, latest_coder_output: str, runtime_guidance: dict | None

children.title: config.py
children.purpose: System prompts for coder and reviewer agents, plus MAX_TURNS configuration.
responsibilities: Define CODER system prompt (senior backend engineer, output-only implementation)
Define REVIEWER system prompt (production code review with STATUS protocol)
Set MAX_TURNS = 30 as the iteration limit

children.title: CODER
children.description: Coder system prompt: instructs the agent to implement/revise code based on reviewer feedback, preserve functionality, and output only the updated code without explanations.

children.title: REVIEWER
children.description: Reviewer system prompt: instructs the agent to evaluate implementation across 9 categories (correctness, coverage, error handling, API design, code quality, etc.), report issues with Category/Severity/Description/Suggested Fix, and output STATUS: APPROVED when requirements are satisfied.

components.title: Streamlit Benchmark Dashboard
components.description: Streamlit dashboard that runs 3 concurrent workflow configurations (baseline, monitor-only, adaptive) and visualizes results with token charts, escalation charts, and live activity feeds.
responsibilities: Display 3-column live feed: Baseline, Monitor Only, Adaptive Intervention
Run stream_single for each configuration sequentially
Build markdown feed rows showing sender, tokens, latency, flags, interventions
Compute metrics: token reduction %, turns saved, intervention recovery rate
Render Plotly bar/line charts for token and escalation comparison

children.title: app.py
children.purpose: Streamlit dashboard with 3-column benchmark workflow viewer, live feeds, metric cards, and Plotly charts.
responsibilities: Configure page with custom dark CSS styling
Provide sidebar: about section, detection signal explanations, benchmark goal
Provide collapsible prompt configuration section
Run 3 workflows sequentially and display live feeds
Compute and display saved tokens, turns, intervention recovery stats
Render tokens-per-turn bar chart and reviewer escalation line chart

children.title: build_feed_md()
children.description: Builds a markdown string for the live feed. Each row shows agent sender icon, turn number, tokens, latency, new flag badges, and deadlock/termination indicators. Also renders runtime guidance intervention badges.

children.title: tokens_by_turn()
children.description: Aggregates tokens per turn from workflow event rows for chart rendering.

components.title: FastAPI Backend Server
components.description: FastAPI WebSocket server that runs 3 workflow configurations concurrently and streams real-time events and logs to the Next.js frontend.
responsibilities: Accept WebSocket connections at /ws
Receive start command with task and prompts
Run 3 workflows concurrently via asyncio.gather: baseline (no detector), monitor_only (detector stops), protected (adaptive interventions)
Stream per-turn events and debug logs via WebSocket JSON messages
Send completion summaries with metrics
Serve /health and /version endpoints

children.title: main.py
children.purpose: FastAPI WebSocket server managing benchmark workflows and streaming real-time data.
responsibilities: Configure CORS for localhost and Vercel deployment
Accept /ws WebSocket connections and orchestrate 3 concurrent workflows
Stream per-turn events and drained log lines to connected clients
Build and send final WorkflowSummary for each configuration
Serve GET /, /health, /version with git metadata and debug inspection

children.title: websocket_endpoint()
children.description: WebSocket handler at /ws. Accepts connection, waits for 'start' message with task and prompts, runs 3 workflows concurrently via asyncio.gather (baseline, monitor_only, protected), and streams events/logs. Handles WebSocket disconnect and exceptions.

children.title: run_workflow()
children.description: Async function that runs a single workflow via stream_single() in a thread pool executor. Streams per-turn events as JSON, drains stdout logs, and sends final summary. Handles errors gracefully with fallback summary.
children.inputs: websocket: WebSocket, workflow_id: str, task: str, coder_prompt: str, reviewer_prompt: str, use_sentinel: bool, adaptive_interventions: bool

children.title: log_utils.py
children.purpose: Thread-safe stdout capture utility that intercepts print() calls and buffers them for WebSocket streaming.
responsibilities: Replace sys.stdout with a thread-safe capturing wrapper
Pass through writes to original stdout while buffering
Provide drain() to retrieve and clear buffered logs

children.title: install()
children.description: Installs the stdout capture. Replaces sys.stdout with a _Capture instance that buffers all output and forwards to original stdout.

components.title: Next.js Frontend
components.description: TypeScript React application with Tailwind dark theme. Provides real-time workflow monitoring with WebSocket connection management, 3-column workflow panels, Recharts visualization, and CSV export.
responsibilities: Connect to FastAPI server via WebSocket at /ws
Manage 3 concurrent workflow states (baseline, monitor_only, protected)
Display per-turn feed rows with agent, tokens, latency, flags, and intervention badges
Render Recharts bar chart (tokens per turn) and line chart (reviewer escalation)
Render benchmark results with metric cards, intervention history, recovery stats
Export benchmark results as CSV with per-turn detail

children.title: types/index.ts
children.purpose: All TypeScript interfaces for the frontend: MessageData, StreamEvent, WorkflowSummary, WorkflowState, LogEntry, RuntimeIntervention.
responsibilities: Type workflow event data flowing from WebSocket
Define per-message structure, per-event structure, summary structure, and intervention structure

children.title: lib/useBenchmark.ts
children.purpose: React hook managing WebSocket lifecycle, 3 workflow states, log ingestion, and connection fallback.
responsibilities: Manage WebSocket open/send/onmessage/onerror/onclose lifecycle
Route per-workflow events to correct state (baseline, monitor_only, protected)
Ingest debug logs with auto-incrementing IDs
Handle incomplete connections with graceful summary fallback

children.title: useBenchmark()
children.description: React hook that returns 3 WorkflowState objects (baseline, monitorOnly, protected), running flag, start callback, and logs array. Manages WebSocket connection, dispatches events to workflow states, handles connection loss with fallback summaries.
children.outputs: Object with baseline, monitorOnly, protected, running, start, task, coderPrompt, reviewerPrompt, logs

children.title: lib/exportCSV.ts
children.purpose: Generates and downloads CSV benchmark results with per-turn data and summary metrics.
responsibilities: Generate CSV header with task config, summary metrics (tokens, turns, reduction, interventions)
Append per-turn rows for baseline and protected workflows
Trigger browser CSV file download with formatted filename

children.title: generateCSV()
children.description: Generates a complete CSV string from baseline and protected workflow states. Includes summary section (task, prompts, token/turn metrics, intervention stats) and per-turn rows for both workflows.
children.inputs: baseline: WorkflowState, protectedState: WorkflowState, task: str, coderPrompt: str, reviewerPrompt: str

children.title: downloadCSV()
children.description: Triggers browser download of CSV file via dynamically created anchor element with Blob URL.

children.title: components/BenchmarkResults.tsx
children.purpose: Full results section: metric cards, intervention history grid, CSV export button with toast notification, and Recharts integration.
responsibilities: Compute token reduction %, tokens/turns saved from baseline vs protected summaries
Display 3 workflow stat cards (tokens, turns) and 3 comparison metric cards
Render intervention history grid with per-intervention outcome coloring
Integrate TokenChart and ReviewerChart Recharts components
Export CSV with loading spinner and toast notification

children.title: handleExport()
children.description: CSV export handler with debounce, loading state management, and toast notification for success/error outcomes.

children.title: components/WorkflowPanel.tsx
children.purpose: Per-workflow column component showing status indicator, live feed of events, and summary footer.
responsibilities: Render status indicator with color-coded dot (green=complete, red=deadlock, blue=running)
Render scrollable FeedRow list from workflow rows
Display summary footer with turns, tokens, flags, and intervention recovery stats

children.title: components/FeedRow.tsx
children.purpose: Single event row in the workflow feed showing sender, turn number, tokens, latency, flags, and intervention badges.
responsibilities: Display sender with color-coded dot (green=coder, blue=reviewer, red=deadlock)
Show token count, latency, turn number
Render new_flag pills and runtime guidance intervention badges

children.title: components/TokenChart.tsx
children.purpose: Recharts bar chart comparing tokens per turn between baseline (red) and adaptive (green) workflows.
responsibilities: Aggregate tokens by turn number from StreamEvent rows
Render grouped bar chart with ResponsiveContainer

children.title: components/ReviewerChart.tsx
children.purpose: Recharts line chart showing reviewer response size over turns as an escalation signal indicator.
responsibilities: Filter reviewer-only events and map by reviewer turn number
Render line chart comparing baseline vs protected reviewer token growth

children.title: components/ConfigSection.tsx
children.purpose: Collapsible configuration form with task, coder prompt, and reviewer prompt text areas and Run button.
responsibilities: Manage task, coder prompt, and reviewer prompt state
Collapsible section UI with default prompt values
Trigger benchmark start with onStart callback

children.title: components/LogPanel.tsx
children.purpose: Collapsible debug log viewer with auto-scroll, workflow-colored tags, and text file export.
responsibilities: Display workflow-colored log entries with timestamps
Auto-scroll to bottom on new entries
Provide download logs as .txt file

children.title: app/page.tsx
children.purpose: Main page composing all frontend components into the 3-column layout.
responsibilities: Compose ConfigSection, 3x WorkflowPanel, LogPanel, and BenchmarkResults
Wire useBenchmark hook state and callbacks to child components
